note: G8 M6. A maximum of 30 in steps of 10 makes this six-block program wrap where the shipped defaults need ten thousand blocks, and the effect is the same: every number is handed out twice. The duplicate test only ever looked at the numbering the run replaced, found each target unique there, and wrote the target's new number — a value the program now carries twice, which a control resolves to the first block that matches, so a G71 P-Q can rough the wrong pass. Both values are reported and left as they are now, and the run is asked about before it happens.
